A group of gray-[[Color/Legends|colored]], heavily-cratered '''asteroids''' was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="DotJ7" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,793 BBY]]. That year,<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'' confirms the date of ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]''.</ref> the [[Devourer (Rakatan ship)|''Devourer'']]&mdash;a [[Rakatan ship|starship]] under the command of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]&mdash;vanished from Rakatan [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] at that location.<ref name="DotJ7" />

Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later,<ref name="DotJ6">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref> during her search for [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]]&mdash;a [[Force Hound]] of the Infinite Empire who had been aboard the ''Devourer''&mdash;his fellow [[The Force/Legends|Force]] Hound [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]] stopped her [[Rakatan scout ship|scout starship]] at the same exact location in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] from where the ''Devourer'' had disappeared, which brought her near the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] group. While drifting in space nearby, Trill used both her [[Force sense/Legends|senses]] and memories of Xesh to pick up his trail in the Force, and then proceeded to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] her starship away from the asteroids in further search of the Force Hound,<ref name="DotJ7" /> which ultimately led Trill to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Krev Coeur]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]].<ref name="DotJ8">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 3|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 3]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified group of asteroids was first depicted in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|seventh]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic-books]]. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DotJ7" /> on [[December 19]], [[2012]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54147/star_wars_dawn_of_the_jedi_-_prisoner_of_bogan_2012_2|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi - Prisoner of Bogan (2012) #2}}</ref>
